instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Read the events in a time range from one of the person's own calendars, on whichever provider it is on, and give them back as time blocks", and give it provider (google-calendar or outlook-calendar, a row of tools/calendar/read-data/calendar-providers.json), connection (your connected account by its handle), range_start and range_end (ISO times).
2. The AI calls do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:read-calendar-events and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: the events of that calendar in the range as time blocks that read-time-blocks and lay-out-a-calendar-view understand; a cancelled event is marked cancelled and an all-day event is a date. It reads only.
